item.content:encoded:
Huh. I had read Bright's 001 proposal, but that was a long time ago, and it certainly wasn't something I was consciously trying to go along with. I guess it just colored how I thought of the Factory.

I guess the style is also reminiscent of Scan's 001 proposal, though I believe the reasons why the Factory speaks that way are different. The whole "very unfortunate regrettable apologies etc" bit is intended to be insincere, as denoted by overstating it, and the etc.

The last three lines (especially the last two) are supposed to be something of a creed of the Factory, less related to this SCP than to my view of the GoI as a whole.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Ah, I'll fix that typo. You could probably use this as an improvised water cannon, but you would look very silly. I did that calculation too, but it's more complex than that, thanks to the fact that the Earth is a sphere, and these are circles we're trying to tile. As I said, it's an open problem, so I just went with 100 as a round number in the right ballpark.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Well, if we're talking about the ballpark here, a 761-mile-radius circle has an area of about 4.7 million square kilometers — probably a bit more, given that it's on a sphere so it'll bulge. The Earth's total surface area is about 510 million square kilometers. The math is such that to be absolutely certain that someone isn't gonna get their fill of 449 when all are going, there should be 109 of them.

Incidentally, what pressure does the 449-A come out at when the cone's going at full tilt? I'm imagining someone using one of these like an improvised water cannon and laughing.

Also,

To date, all individuals SCP-449 instances have been recovered from had gone to extreme lengths

I'd recommend changing that to "all individuals from which SCP-449 instances have been recovered". It reads better.
